title: Am I Joyful or Am I Happy?
fullTitle: Soul Feast #26 – Am I Joyful or Am I Happy?
description: Many people use the words “joy” and “happiness” interchangeably, but are they really the same? In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the profound difference between the fleeting highs of happiness—driven by external circumstances—and the deep, unwavering presence of joy.

At the heart of this conversation is the concept of authentic power—choosing love over fear, even when fear is present. Gary breaks down how happiness is dependent on the external world, fluctuating with life’s ups and downs, while joy is an unshakable state of being that emerges when we move beyond fear-based reactions.

The key to experiencing true joy is to practice emotional awareness, learning to distinguish between fearful and loving parts of our personality. When we act from love—choosing gratitude, patience, and appreciation—we step into our authentic power and free ourselves from the illusion that external circumstances define our well-being .
